changes.reason: Failed trace SDK startup now unwinds owned resources before retry; failed or timed-out rollback retains a terminal shutdown failure. Trace-only SDK configuration prevents implicit log/metric exporters from escaping startup ownership. Automatic instrumentation replaced by a custom instance is disabled before construction so every activated instance remains owned by the attempt.

kubernetes.reason: Uses the existing Node SDK lifecycle and process-local rollback; no Kubernetes-specific provider is introduced.
constraints: Node Host only. Local real SDK/provider/processor tests inject startup failures and an exporter; no Kubernetes deployment certification is claimed. Failed rollback requires a process restart.

aws-lambda.reason: Reuses the same Node startup rollback before invocation work; no execution wrapper or Layer owns initialization.
constraints: Existing Lambda Host lifecycle owns initialization and per-invocation flush. No live AWS startup/teardown certification is claimed. Failed rollback requires replacing the process.

cloudflare.reason: The Node SDK and automatic instrumentation require Node APIs; the package does not claim Workers isolate compatibility.
constraints: No Workers provider or Node Container profile is introduced.
